newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Spring to leave for Middle East on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Spring to leave for Middle East on Sunday.

text.p: European Union foreign ministers agreed on Saturday that Irish Foreign Minister Dick Spring would leave for Israel on Sunday, an Irish government official said.
"It is now planned that Dick Spring will go to Israel and Gaza tomorrow, pending the logistics," he said.
Earlier at a summit, EU leaders decided to send Spring on a peace mission to meet both Palestinians and Israelis.
The EU has been frustrated by its exclusion from U.S.-brokered Middle East peace moves.

Ireland is current EU president. Its prime minister, John Bruton, said it was appropriate that Europe should have a significant role in helping negotiations since it is by far the largest donor of humanitarian and development aid in support of the peace process.
EU officials said it was not yet clear who Spring would meet or where he would go. They said it was still being worked out.
